personnel.rule: The Traffic Control Review Form signer attests being trained and/or certified in fundamental TTC principles and responsible for setup and maintenance for the duration, on the jobsite.

hazards.rule: MHT Manual violations carry a published, tiered dollar ladder ($125-$1,500 by violation type and offense count) — the first such ladder in the corpus.

tiers.label: Public Space Traffic permit
tiers.definition: Dedicated TC permit type — mobility impact alone triggers it, no ground disturbance needed (dumpsters/moving containers in ROW included; food trucks parking diagonally).

notes.rule: 'Public Space' is Greeley's official term for the ROW — surfaces should say 'Public Space permit', not 'ROW permit'. TC plans are 'Method of Handling Traffic' (MHT) plans.

source.doc: Greeley Public Space Permitting page + TC Review Form

notes.rule: Contractors need a Greeley Business License before Public Space work; permitting via the eTrakit portal; same-day issuance on payment.
Work completed without inspection: possible removal + corrective action + 20% of permit total penalty (percentage — not renderable as a fixed meter).
Extensions: up to 3, apply at least 5 days pre-expiration; expired = reapply (prior fees credited). Application void at 30 days if incomplete.

source.doc: Greeley Permitting Requirements for Activities within Public Space

items.label: High-impact transverse cut (<5 ft) — PQI High/Medium/Low
items.note: High $28.06 / Medium $14.02 / Low $0.39 per SF (High encoded; tiers in note).

items.label: Potholes — PQI High/Medium/Low
items.note: High $62.35 / Medium $31.17 / Low $7.79 each (High encoded; tiers in note).

items.label: Re-inspection
items.note: Plus hourly — charged when called out more than twice without being ready.

fees.note: Degradation fees are keyed to the published Pavement Quality Index map (High >70 / Medium 40-70 / Low <=40) — the most sophisticated street-cut pricing in the corpus. Card +2.8%; ACH free.

meters.note: 'MHT Manual Violation Penalty: $125-$1,500 (based on violation type and number of offenses, see COG MHT Manual for more information).'

leads.label: Full road closures with complete detours — MHT plan review
leads.note: 5 working days advance notice; 72-hour pre-construction notice strongly recommended.
